title: 電気電子プログラミング
subtitle: Programming for Electrical and Electronic Engineering
keywords: Computer Programming 2.C Language 3.Control Structure 4.Algorithm 5.Electrical and Electronic Engineers
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) learn the fundamental concepts and methods of programming using C language. (2) learn how to solve problems and transform the solutions into computer programs written in C language. The goal of this course is to provide an introduction not just to C but also to logical thinking. (3) learn some applications of C programming in electrical and electronic engineering.
advice: This course is designed to familiarize students with computer programming, with an emphasis on a widely used language, C. The classes incorporate lecture with hands-on programming exercises. We will cover the following materials: 1. Elementary programming in C 2. Selection statements 3. Repetition statements 4. Modular programming with functions a. Integrated learning - For applied problems related to the field of electrical and electronic engineering - b. Overview of advanced C language syntax Students should be aware of the teacher's instructions in the class, because the detailed course schedules may change depending on the students' progress in understanding.
books: Textbooks: None Reference books: やさしく学べるC言語 ANSI規格準拠[森北出版]、新・明解C言語 入門編(第2版)[SBクリエイティブ]、猫でもわかるC言語プログラミング(第3版)[SBクリエイティブ] Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: You are expected to bring your Windows laptop to class with you to work on programming exercises. No prior programming knowledge is required. This course and “Computer Engineering for Electrical and Electronic Engineers” are complementary. “Feedback Control” is related to this course.

activityGoals.body: Be able to demonstrate problem-solving skills by developing algorithms to solve problems.
Be able to write C programs that perform sequential operations.
Be able to incorporate the selection control structure into C programs.
Be able to incorporate the repetition control structure into C programs.
Be able to decompose the solution into modules at the function level.
Be able to make a computer execute a program you have written in C language.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Develop modular and efficient programs in C efficiently. (2) Identify a problem in electrical and electronic engineering and provide a proper solution by designing algorithms and implementing computer programs. (3) Be comfortable using C.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Design algorithms to solve rudimentary problems in electric and electronic engineering. (2) Demonstrate basic skills in writing and implementing simple structured programs in C. (3) Describe the fundamentals of C based on the hands-on knowledge of programming.
